value.rationale: A natural class-sum convolution operator on the additive matrix space has a macroscopically large kernel whose precise spectral structure is nonobvious. The theorem supplies every eigenvalue as an exact matrix statistic, an arbitrary-dimensional finite nullity expression, and a limiting complex and singular spectral measure with an explicitly computable zero atom. The field-size scaling distinguishes a stable nonzero kernel fraction. These are standard, motivated operator invariants, not narrow arbitrary numerical slices.
